tasks.gr8-listening-speaking-t3: Topic: Listening and Speaking (Grade 8 Term 3). Cover prepared speech, discussion, role play, and oral response to literature. Ask learners to choose effective speech structure, identify suitable discussion behaviour, respond to role-play prompts, and select evidence-based oral responses to short literary extracts.
tasks.gr8-reading-viewing-t3: Topic: Reading and Viewing (Grade 8 Term 3). Cover drama scenes, short stories, poetry, visual support, and literary response. Ask learners to identify speaker and conflict, interpret mood and imagery, retrieve textual evidence, and compare personal responses to scene or poem questions.
tasks.gr8-writing-presenting-t3: Topic: Writing and Presenting (Grade 8 Term 3). Cover descriptive essays, narrative writing, formal letters, project writing, and presentation planning. Ask learners to identify format features, structure paragraphs for effect, choose relevant supporting details, and apply revision choices across project drafts.
tasks.gr8-language-structures-t3: Topic: Language Structures (Grade 8 Term 3). Cover adverbs, prepositions, clauses, punctuation, editing, and vocabulary development. Ask learners to select accurate word forms, identify clause patterns, choose suitable prepositions, and improve sentence clarity through punctuation and editing tasks.
